actions_now: Prune lower infected leaves up to 30 cm from ground.
Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L water or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2.0 g/L.
prevention: Practice 3-year crop rotation avoiding Solanaceous crops (potato, brinjal, chilli).
Ensure proper plant spacing (60 x 45 cm) for adequate air circulation.
Mulch soil around plants to prevent soil-splash pathogen transmission.
Water crops early morning using drip irrigation rather than overhead sprinklers.
text: Diagnosis: Tomato - Early Blight. Severity: Moderate. Immediate action: Prune lower infected leaves up to 30 cm from ground.
